title: The world lost nearly 1 billion barrels in oil supply over the past 75 days. Why investors aren’t worrying enough.
summary: Global oil prices have climbed by nearly 50% since the the end of February, but the rise pales in comparison to an estimated loss of nearly 1 billion barrels since the start of the Iran war 75 days ago.

title: My wife and I retired with 22 times our income. Why don’t more people do what we did?
summary: “The vast majority of people I’ve known are intimidated by money’s power, imbue it with almost magical qualities.”
